metadata.description: Application (client) ID of the crdr-reader app registration

value.evidence: @if(empty(body('Setting_row')), concat('no enabled crdr_tenantsetting row for ''', items('Each_setting_key')?['crdr_value'], ''''), concat('crdr_tenantsetting ', items('Each_setting_key')?['crdr_value'], ' enabled but scope ''', first(body('Setting_row'))?['crdr_scope'], ''' does not cover ''', join(body('Product_list'), ', '), ''''))

parameters.$filter: @concat('crdr_facet eq ', string(items('Each_clause')?['crdr_assetfacet']), ' and (', join(body('Value_filters'), ' or '), ')', if(contains(createArray('off', 'false', 'no', '0'), toLower(trim(coalesce(first(body('Config_demo'))?['crdr_value'], '')))), ' and crdr_asset/crdr_source ne 169890002', ''))

@concat('_crdr_signal_value eq ', items('Each_match_signal'), if(contains(createArray('off', 'false', 'no', '0'), toLower(trim(coalesce(first(body('Config_demo'))?['crdr_value'], '')))), ' and crdr_source ne 169890002', ''))

inputs.where: @and(not(equals(item()?['crdr_status'], 169890002)), not(equals(item()?['crdr_status'], 169890003)), if(empty(item()?['_crdr_asset_value']), not(contains(body('Setting_names'), item()?['crdr_name'])), not(contains(outputs('Unique_asset_ids'), item()?['_crdr_asset_value']))))

parameters.item/crdr_gaps: @if(equals(actions('Collect')?['status'], 'Succeeded'), 'Setting exposures are live only (crdr_tenantsetting describes the real tenant). Agent capabilities that need Dataverse or Kit detail (uses_mcp, http_action, autonomous_trigger) are unknown, so agents are not matched on them.', concat('Collect scope: ', actions('Collect')?['status']))
parameters.item/crdr_name: @if(greater(length(coalesce(concat('match ', formatDateTime(trigger()?['startTime'], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), if(equals(actions('Collect')?['status'], 'Succeeded'), ': ', ': FAILED: '), 'signals ', string(variables('Signals')), ', exposures created ', string(variables('Created')), ' updated ', string(variables('Updated')), ' unmatched ', string(variables('Unmatched'))), '')), 200), substring(concat('match ', formatDateTime(trigger()?['startTime'], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), if(equals(actions('Collect')?['status'], 'Succeeded'), ': ', ': FAILED: '), 'signals ', string(variables('Signals')), ', exposures created ', string(variables('Created')), ' updated ', string(variables('Updated')), ' unmatched ', string(variables('Unmatched'))), 0, 200), coalesce(concat('match ', formatDateTime(trigger()?['startTime'], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), if(equals(actions('Collect')?['status'], 'Succeeded'), ': ', ': FAILED: '), 'signals ', string(variables('Signals')), ', exposures created ', string(variables('Created')), ' updated ', string(variables('Updated')), ' unmatched ', string(variables('Unmatched'))), ''))
